##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata Digital India Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata Ethical Direct Plan Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

text:
Scheme: Tata Small Cap Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata Nifty 50 Index Direct | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Titanium Hybrid Long Short Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata Nifty Capital Markets Index Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata Money Market Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata ELSS Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

You can download your account statement or capital gains report by visiting the official Tata Mutual Fund website (https://www.tatamutualfund.com), navigating to the 'Investor Services' section, and selecting 'Account Statement'. metadata.scheme_name: General Tata Mutual Fund Information

text: Scheme: General Info | General Exit Load Information: Exit load is a fee charged by the AMC when an investor redeems or switches out of a mutual fund scheme before a specified period. The specific exit load for each Tata Mutual Fund scheme is mentioned in the Scheme Information Document (SID) and on the fund's page on Groww. For example, many equity funds have an exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year, but some like Tata Small Cap Fund have 0.5% if redeemed within 30 days.

metadata.scheme_name: General Tata Mutual Fund Information

##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Scheme: Tata Resources & Energy Fund Direct Growth | Section: Understand terms 
##### Expense ratio  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.  
##### Tax  
A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.  
##### Exit load  
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.  
##### Stamp duty  
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.
